name: Building a System
description: Room goals, channel layouts, signal chain, power and wiring, decided in the right order. From an empty floor to a system you can measure and upgrade.

name: Home Theater
description: Channel layouts, height layers, centre-channel dialogue, bass management and the honest trade-offs between a living room and a dedicated cinema room.

name: Hi-Fi & Stereo
description: Source, amplification and loudspeakers as one chain: stereo imaging, seat geometry, analogue sources and the small moves that actually change the presentation.

name: Room Acoustics
description: Modes, reflections, placement, treatment and calibration, measured in ordinary rooms rather than read off an anechoic spec sheet.

name: Speakers & Components
description: How drivers, crossovers, cabinets, amplifiers and sources behave together, explained by mechanism and measurement instead of model numbers.

name: Buying & Comparisons
description: Category decisions, budget tiers and spec-sheet traps, with the room and system conditions under which the honest answer changes.

name: Measurements & Method
description: Test protocols, tolerances, frequency-response reading, failed experiments and the editorial standard behind every published number.
